job.title: Junior Digital & E-commerce Marketeer @ Pharma & More BV
job.description:
**Over Pharma & More**

Pharma & More is een snelgroeiend Belgisch bedrijf achter een portfolio van sterke health & beauty merken (Couleurs de Noir, The Remedy, Vitasonar, Renée Lunettes), aanwezig in meer dan 1.200 apotheken. Vitasonar is een van onze strategische merken. Het wil uitgroeien tot een innovatief gezondheidsplatform voor vrouwen die natuurlijke oplossingen zoeken. We verkopen via apotheken, maar ook steeds meer rechtstreeks via onze eigen webshop. Daar kom jij in beeld.

**De functie**

Je maakt content die converteert. Samen met de Brand Manager Vitasonar zorg je dat onze digitale kanalen niet alleen mooi ogen, maar ook verkopen. Je leert snel wat werkt en waarom, en je stuurt bij op basis van cijfers.

Concreet:

* Je bouwt en optimaliseert productpagina’s en landingspagina’s op onze Shopify-webshop.
* Je maakt e-mailcampagnes en geautomatiseerde flows in Klaviyo.
* Je maakt creatives en varianten voor Meta-advertenties, en je test wat beter presteert.
* Je beheert onze organische socialmediakanalen en werkt samen met influencers.
* Je volgt resultaten op (conversie, open rates, ROAS, ...) en vertaalt ze naar concrete verbeteringen.
* Je zet AI-tools slim in om meer en snellere content te maken, zonder in te boeten op kwaliteit.
* Je levert content aan voor onze apotheekpartners en voor Vitasonar-events.

**Jouw profiel**

* Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma, bij voorkeur in (digitale) marketing, e-commerce of een verwante richting. Starters zijn welkom.
* Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met e-commerce en online verkopen. Je wil begrijpen waarom een bezoeker wel of niet koopt.
* Je bent digitaal creatief. Met Canva, Figma of vergelijkbare tools ga je vlot aan de slag.
* Je denkt in cijfers: data schrikt je niet af, ze maakt je nieuwsgierig.
* Ervaring met Shopify, Klaviyo of Meta Ads is een plus, maar geen vereiste.
* Je wil groeien, durft fouten te maken en leert er snel uit.
* Je hebt affiniteit met gezondheid en een gezonde levensstijl.
* Je bent Nederlandstalig. Kennis van het Frans is een voordeel.

**Wat bieden we**

* Een voltijdse (5/5) of 4/5-functie bij een snelgroeiend Belgisch bedrijf met sterke merken
* Een steile leercurve in e-commerce en performance marketing, met echte verantwoordelijkheid
* Een gedreven team dat jou laat groeien
* Een marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen
* Kantoor in Gent (Drongen), met de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken

job.title: Technical Project Manager @ Kaluza (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
* **Location**: Paris - Hybrid
* **Level:** C3
* **Team**: Client Delivery
* **Salary**: Paris €63,900 - €78,100
* **Reporting to**: Principal Programme Manager

This role is based in Paris and requires existing right to work in the EU. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.  
  
**What will I be doing?**

As the Technical Project Manager (Platform & Integration), you are the critical link between our core engineering capabilities and our major energy clients. You don't just manage tasks; you orchestrate the journey from internal platform stability to successful client deployment.

Your mission is to ensure that our Environment, Infrastructure, Security and DataMart roadmap is perfectly synchronized with client integration needs. You will act as the single point of accountability, translating complex platform architecture into seamless client implementations, ensuring that what we build internally delivers maximum value and reliability to the external market.

**Responsibilities**

* Client Integration & Technical Governance (External Focus)

  + Technical Consulting: Serve as a primary technical contact during client integration projects, translating internal platform architecture and dependencies into clear, actionable requirements for the client's technical teams.
  + Environment Alignment: Own the technical coordination for critical implementation elements across - infrastructure, access, services, APIs, Applications, and DataMart ensuring setup/configuration of client testing and production environments.
  + Security Assurance & Data Protection: Work with clients and Kaluza SMEs to ensure the kaluza platform meets minimum security and data protection requirements. Manage the definition of needs, implementation approach, validation and auditing activities.
  + Technical Risk Communication: Proactively communicate technical risks, constraints, and trade-offs inherent in the implementation process to client stakeholders and internal commercial teams.
* Core Platform & Infrastructure Delivery (Internal Focus)

  + Infrastructure Roadmap: Manage internal projects focused on the enhancement and stability of our Technical Infrastructure (Cloud environments, containerization, security tooling) and Tech Operations maturity.
  + Engineering Alignment: Collaborate with Platform Architects, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams to define project scope, secure resources, and manage technical dependencies.
  + Reliability & Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and data projects adhere to security protocols, regulatory requirements, and internal reliability targets.
* Delivery Methodologies & Reporting

  + Agile Proficiency: Apply expert knowledge of Scrum and Kanban within an engineering context, managing sprint planning, backlog refinement, and continuous delivery practices.
  + System Integration: Also apply your organisational and management skills to large scale, fixed time system integration programs in a way that promotes transparency and minimises delivery risk.
  + Reporting: Provide transparent, data-driven reporting using Jira dashboards and quantifiable metrics, clearly showing the status of both internal delivery and external client dependencies.
  + Blocker Resolution: Facilitate technical and architectural decisions, acting as the primary point of contact to resolve critical technical roadblocks for both internal and client teams.
  + Team / Relationship Management: Form strong working relationships with clients and internal teams. Effectively operate in a matrix team structure. Lead and facilitate meetings and ceremonies.

**About You**

Ideally you’ll have/be

* Circa 5 years: of experience as a Technical Project/Program Manager, specifically in roles that required simultaneous management of internal platform engineering and B2B client integrations.
* Hands-on exposure: to the technicalities of, environment provisioning, security and data projects.
* Proven track record of navigating the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within a high-growth SaaS, FinTech, or EnergyTech environment.

What will set you apart

* Business level French language skills
* Experience in the Energy or Utility sector is highly advantageous, particularly regarding industry-specific data standards.
* A ‘can do’ attitude, that is able to create high-performing teams.

**Kaluza Values**  
Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: **Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.**

**We want the best people**

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

job.title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris) @ Dust (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
**About Dust**
==============

**Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.**

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.**

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

**The role**
============

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.
* Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.
* Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.
* Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.
* Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.
* Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.
* Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.
* Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.
* Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.
* Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.
* Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

* A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.
* Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.
* A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.
* Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.
* Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.
* The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.
* Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.
* High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.
* Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

**What success looks like**
===========================

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

**Location**
============

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.  
  
That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

**Why Dust**
============

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

*Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.*

**Learn how we think and work.**

* Our product constitution, *a story about our mission*
* Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, **Stanislas Polu**, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.
* Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, **Gabriel Hubert**, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation Range: €180K - €200K

Marketing Executive – Europe @ Optimas Solutions (Sarreguemines, GE, FR)
job.description:
**Marketing Executive – Europe**

About Optimas International

Optimas International is a global specialist in engineering and industrial distribution, providing fastener distribution and supply chain solutions to manufacturers across the UK, Europe, India and South East Asia, and China. We are entering a period of focused growth, built around six priority global verticals, our existing customer base in each country, and a programme of acquisitions.

Our central marketing function is organised to generate leads, control the sales pipeline and support regional sales teams to win. Regional Marketing Executives are the on-the-ground link between that central function and the sales team in each market.

About the role

As Marketing Executive for Europe, based in Hambach, France, you will be the on-the-ground marketing resource for the regional sales team. You will turn pipeline requirements into practical marketing activity, keep the regional pipeline active in HubSpot, plan and deliver the exhibitions, networking events and campaigns that put Optimas in front of the right customers in France and the wider European market, and help the sales team win new customers and grow share of wallet with existing ones.

This is a hands-on, varied role for someone who enjoys being close to customers and sales colleagues, and who can run an exhibition stand as confidently as a HubSpot email campaign.

Purpose

Turn pipeline requirements into regional marketing activity, keep the regional pipeline queue active for the sales team to work, and support BD teams and P&L leads to win new customers and increase share of wallet with existing customers, with revenue generation as the end goal, without owning deal closing.

Key responsibilities

Exhibitions and trade shows

* Manage the regional exhibition programme end to end: recommending shows with sales leaders, booking space, managing budgets and coordinating suppliers and logistics.

* Work with Communications and Brand to deliver on-brand stand design, graphics, literature and giveaways.

* Plan pre-show promotion, including customer invitations, meeting scheduling, social media and email campaigns.

* Organise stand staffing and briefings, and attend shows to support the sales team on the stand.

* Make sure every lead captured is entered into HubSpot promptly and followed up, and report on results and return on investment after each show.

Networking and customer events

* Plan and run networking events, customer events, seminars, open days and plant visits requested by BD teams and P&L leads.

* Identify relevant industry associations, trade bodies and networking opportunities in the region, and coordinate Optimas participation.

* Manage invitations, attendance, logistics and follow-up for each event, capturing contacts and outcomes in HubSpot.

Pipeline and HubSpot

* Own pipeline queue management for the region, keeping 10 to 20 live leads in HubSpot for the sales team to work.

* Build a regular working rhythm with the regional sales team, in line with the cadence set by the Pipeline & Market Intelligence Manager, sharing priorities, feedback and lead quality so marketing and sales operate as one team.

* Add local targets to the master HubSpot list and share local market intelligence with the Pipeline & Market Intelligence team.

* Follow HubSpot workflow and data standards, and flag data issues to the Pipeline & Market Intelligence team and BI.

Existing customer growth

* Support the regional sales team to increase share of wallet with existing customers through targeted campaigns, events and account-focused activity.

* Work with the Existing Customers Research Analyst to act on cross-sell, product and plant opportunities identified in the region.

* Help coordinate activity with other regions where a global customer has sites we do not yet serve.

Regional campaigns and collateral

* Plan, run and manage regional campaigns in response to pipeline requirements, with revenue generation as the end goal, including email, LinkedIn and digital activity built in HubSpot.

* Adapt central campaigns and content for France and the wider European market, including localisation and translation where needed.

* Create the local marketing materials the sales team needs to open and close new business, using approved templates where provided.

* Raise requests for new content and designs with the Senior Brand & Graphic Designer, providing clear briefs and local insight.

* Track campaign results in HubSpot, report on leads, pipeline and, where trackable, revenue contribution, and use the results to improve future campaigns.

Key relationships

* Reports to: Marketing Manager.

* Works closely with: Regional BD teams and P&L leads, the Pipeline & Market Intelligence team, Communications and Brand, fellow regional Marketing Executives, and the BI team.

* External: Exhibition organisers, event venues, stand builders, agencies, printers and industry associations.

Skills and experience

Essential

* Demonstrable experience in a B2B marketing role, including hands-on planning and delivery of exhibitions, trade shows or events.

* Proven ability to manage event budgets, suppliers and logistics to tight deadlines.

* Experience managing campaigns with a clear focus on pipeline and revenue results.

* Experience running email and digital campaigns, and working with HubSpot CRM or a similar platform.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, as well as Word and PowerPoint.

* Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (for example InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop) to adapt approved templates.

* Strong organisational and project management skills, able to manage several events and campaigns at once.

* Comfortable working directly with sales teams and representing the business with customers and at events.

* Degree in marketing, business or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Desirable

* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering or distribution markets.

* Hands-on HubSpot experience.

* An existing network of exhibition organisers, venues and suppliers in France and the wider European market.

Language and communication requirements

* Fluent English, written and spoken, is essential, as the role works daily with central teams and international colleagues.

* Fluent French, written and spoken, is essential.

* Additional European languages are an advantage.

* Confident, personable communicator, able to build relationships quickly with sales colleagues, customers and suppliers.

* Clear, well-organised written communication for briefs, invitations, reports and updates to central teams.

Personal attributes

* Proactive and energetic, with a "make it happen" approach to events and campaigns.

* Highly organised, calm under pressure and attentive to detail.

* Driven and self-motivated, with a strong focus on results, measuring success by leads, pipeline and revenue, not just activity.

* A team player who works well across countries, cultures and functions.

* Flexible and willing to travel and work occasional evenings or weekends around events.

Measures of success

* 10 to 20 live leads maintained in HubSpot for the region at all times.

* Exhibitions and events delivered on time and on budget, with leads captured and followed up.

* Measurable contribution of regional events and campaigns to new pipeline, wins and, where trackable, revenue.

* Growth in share of wallet and new sites won with existing customers in the region.
* Positive feedback from regional sales teams and P&L leads.

* Accurate, up-to-date HubSpot data for regional marketing activity.

Working arrangement

This role is based in Hambach, France, working alongside the local sales team, with occasional travel within France and across Europe for exhibitions, events and customer visits. Some work outside normal hours will be needed around events

This job description is not exhaustive and may be updated in line with the needs of the business.

**Fast-paced, continuous learning:**

**Culture & Team spirit:**
We don’t compromise on our values: Simplicity, Excellence, Benevolence.
  
  
🎭 The role
  
  
Organisation
  
  

* Report to the Head of Marketing.
* Join a Marketing team including another Growth Marketer focused on build/engineering, a Content team of 2, and external partners (SEA agency, Com & Community freelancer).
* Daily collaboration with Content, Product, Sales and Ops.
* Full-time position, hybrid, based in Paris or Marseille.

Missions
  
  
We are looking for a
**full-stack Growth Marketer who builds**
. Your north star is clear: generate traffic, leads, and signups, and convert them.
  
  
You're as much a marketer as you are a builder. You understand our persona, you're happy to call customers, and you know what message converts. And you turn those insights into reality yourself, shipping acquisition tools, automations and AI-powered experiences with low-code and AI.

You will own growth across the entire funnel, including CRM and marketing automation.
  
  
This is not a pure RevOps / ops role, nor a pure paid-media role. It is a hybrid marketer-builder.

* Own acquisition across channels: paid with partners, social and affiliation, plus new acquisition levers you build (low-code, AI, programmatic and satellite/SEO pages, free tools).

* Own lead generation and nurturing that push visitors to signup and trial (content, lead magnets, landing pages, email sequences).
* Own marketing automation and CRM for acquisition and activation journeys (lead scoring, routing, lifecycle). You make it yours, hands-on, as a growth lever, not as a systems admin.
* Build growth tools with low-code and AI: client-facing experiences, automations, enrichment, programmatic approaches. We expect concrete, pioneering use cases, not yet another workflow.

💡: don’t forget Values & Leadership Principles

**Required**

* 4-8 years in growth, digital marketing or performance marketing, in SaaS or e-commerce, ideally on a complex product (subscriptions, multiple offers, activation and conversion mechanics).
* Both a marketer and a builder: a proven track record on acquisition channels AND hands-on building with low-code (Zapier, Make, Retool, Webflow or equivalent) and AI.
* Real, pushed AI use cases you can demo: client-facing or growth tooling, in practice, not in theory.
* Comfortable owning marketing automation and CRM (HubSpot or similar) as a growth lever, hands-on.
* Persona and message sensitivity: you understand users and what makes them convert, and you are not afraid to talk to customers.
* Data-autonomous in a self-service setup: you pull, read and prioritize without needing a data team to move.

**We are NOT looking for**

* Builder at heart and doer: you ship, you iterate, you don't just design processes.

job.title: Developer Relations & Product Marketing Manager @ AppSignal (Werk van thuis, NL)
job.description:
AppSignal is a developer-focused platform building enriched context stores and insights about monitored applications, services, and infrastructure for deeply technical audiences. We are a remote-first company that helps thousands of teams in 60+ countries monitor and improve the performance of their applications.

We’re looking for a **technically curious, hacker- and community-first-minded storyteller** to help us reach developers with a nuanced take on what’s possible with AppSignal as part of their toolset.

This is a hybrid Developer Relations and Product Marketing role for someone who wants to do more than talk about technology. You’ll prototype new ideas and applications, explore emerging developer technologies and workflows, create technical content, engage with our community, and bring an expert voice to the best practices and technical context we provide developers.

Just as importantly, you’ll act as a bridge between the developer ecosystem and AppSignal — bringing what you’re learning from your experiments, conversations, and research back to Product and Engineering to help inform our roadmap.

This role reports directly to the Chief Product Officer and works closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and our developer community.

*We’re looking for somebody within two hours of the Central European Time (CET) time zone for this role.*

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Explore, prototype, and experiment**

* Research emerging developer technologies, tools, and workflows, including the latest changes in AI-assisted and developer agent-based workflows
* Prototype new ideas, applications, integrations, and use cases
* Experiment with new ways developers can use AppSignal as part of their development toolset
* Build demos and proofs-of-concept
* Create compelling developer-focused content
* Create high-quality technical content including tutorials, demo applications, blog posts, videos, livestreams, product walkthroughs, release education, technical videos, and observability best practices
* Develop interesting and differentiated narratives around AppSignal, observability, developer workflows, and emerging technologies
* Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure technical accuracy, credibility, and depth
* Be the face of AppSignal to developers, creators, technical communities, and industry voices

### **Build and grow our developer community**

* Represent AppSignal across online communities, conferences, webinars, podcasts, events, and other developer-focused channels
* Engage with developers across multiple channels including GitHub, Reddit, Discord, LinkedIn, YouTube, X/Twitter, Hacker News, and community forums
* Identify developers, creators, and technical voices AppSignal should know

**Uplevel our team**
--------------------

* Work closely with multiple stakeholders across Product, Support, Sales and Marketing
* Bring a positive team player mindset to be deeply accountable, and celebrate wins across teams
* Bring transparency to the work you do and a willingness to share your expertise

**A Day in the Life**
---------------------

There probably won’t be a typical day in this role — and that’s part of the appeal. You might spend the morning researching changes in developer agent-based workflows and prototyping an idea with AppSignal. Later, you could record a video about what you built, meet with developers in the community, or turn an experiment into a technical article.

You’ll also bring what you’re learning back to Product and Engineering, helping us think about where developer workflows are headed and what that could mean for AppSignal. We expect high autonomy and self organization, attention to detail in this role, paired with an urgency to make an impact.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Technical curiosity and a hacker mindset**

* Demonstrable experience in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, Technical Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering, or a similar developer-facing role
* A reasonable history of visible projects and git commits
* Comfortable with AI, APIs, GitHub, developer tools, and building applications
* Interest in the latest research and papers in a fast-evolving industry

### **A strong technical storyteller**

* Ability to communicate credibly with deeply technical audiences
* Able to turn technical concepts and product capabilities into interesting, useful narratives
* Written, video, or verbal portfolio of work that shows how you like to explain both what something does and why a developer should care
* Developer-first approach to messaging, positioning, and content

### **Comfortable creating and connecting**

* Experience creating technical written, video, demo, or social content
* Comfortable on camera and presenting technical ideas
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Enjoys building genuine relationships within technical communities

### **Nice to have**

* Experience working in B2B SaaS, developer tooling or platforms
* Familiarity with observability, APM, OpenTelemetry, monitoring, or infrastructure tooling is highly preferred

Volop mooie producten en verhalen dus. We zoeken een ervaren collega die deze zelfstandig onder de aandacht brengt van de juiste mensen.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Je werkt onder leiding van Levi, mede-ondernemer van Spelt Bakkers, en nauw samen met Pieter, onze salescollega. Met Levi stem je doelen, prioriteiten en budgetten af. Jij vertaalt die naar een concrete planning en verzorgt zelfstandig de uitvoering en evaluatie. Samen houden jullie de werkzaamheden haalbaar binnen jouw twee werkdagen.

* **Content bedenken en maken.** Je stelt een marketingkalender op, schrijft teksten, houdt onze websites actueel en verzorgt posts voor onze merken en de LinkedIn-profielen van onze ondernemers. Ook beantwoord je reacties op social media.
* **Marketingacties uitvoeren en verbeteren.** Je zet online en offline acties op, test kanalen en combinaties daarvan en meet de resultaten. Je stemt af met onze vormgever en regelt promotiematerialen.
* **Marketing en sales verbinden.** Je denkt mee tijdens het verkoopoverleg, legt leads vast in het CRM en stemt met sales af hoe jullie deze opvolgen.
* **Onze communicatie versterken.** Je helpt ons helder en herkenbaar te communiceren, binnen het team én naar buiten. Denk aan betere klantmails, een prettige telefonische ontvangst en duidelijke informatie.
* **Contact houden met klanten.** Op jouw werkdagen neem je ook de telefoon aan en help je klanten verder. Je voert klanttevredenheidsgesprekken, signaleert verbeterpunten en vertaalt mooie ervaringen, met toestemming, naar content.

**Wie past bij ons?**

Je krijgt energie van een goed idee en zorgt dat het zorgvuldig wordt uitgevoerd. Je maakt makkelijk contact, luistert goed en weet anderen enthousiast mee te nemen. Daarbij voel je aan welke toon bij een klant of situatie past.

Je houdt overzicht, komt afspraken na en hebt oog voor detail. Je beoordeelt kritisch wat een actie oplevert en stelt verbeteringen voor. Je neemt zelf initiatief en weet wanneer afstemming nodig is.

Verder breng je mee:

* Aantoonbare ervaring met het **zelfstandig plannen, uitvoeren en evalueren** van marketing- en communicatieactiviteiten.
* Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, opgebouwd door opleiding en/of ervaring.
* Een goede beheersing van het Nederlands voor teksten en klantcontact.
* Een goede lees- en schrijfvaardigheid in het Engels.
* Ervaring met social media en een eenvoudig website-CMS, zoals WordPress.

Je kunt voorbeelden laten zien van content of campagnes die je zelf hebt gemaakt en toelichten wat je met de resultaten hebt gedaan.

Ervaring met CRM-systemen en kennis van andere talen zijn een pré.

**Wat vind je bij ons?**

Een afwisselende functie in een familiebedrijf met korte lijnen. Je krijgt ruimte om ideeën aan te dragen en binnen de afgesproken doelen zelfstandig uit te voeren. Je werkt aan verschillende merken en staat dicht bij onze klanten en de mensen die onze producten maken.

* **€1.400 tot €1.600 bruto per maand voor 16 uur per week**, afhankelijk van relevante ervaring en vaardigheden, exclusief **8% vakantiegeld**.
* Een werkplek aan de **Nijverheidsweg 24 in Bruinisse**.
* Werkdagen in overleg. Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar **dinsdag en donderdag**, zodat ook het telefonische klantcontact op die dagen goed is geregeld. Andere werkdagen zijn bespreekbaar.

**Laat van je horen**

Lijkt het je leuk om onze producten en verhalen verder te brengen? Mail je cv en een korte motivatie naar **levi@speltbakkers.nl**, ter attentie van Levi Spelt.

Stuur ook een voorbeeld mee van een tekst, post of campagne waar je trots op bent. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw bijdrage, je aanpak en wat het heeft opgeleverd!

Salaris: €20,19 - €23,08 per uur

Verwacht aantal uur: 16.0 – 24.0 per week

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)
* Engels (Vereist)

job.title: Social Media en Content Marketeer Duitsland @ Kamera Express (Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
**Wie zijn wij?**
We zijn gek op alles wat met foto en video te maken heeft en maken onze klanten blij met mooie foto- en videoproducten, bijzondere accessoires en slimme gadgets. Sinds 1995 is Kamera Express dé fotospecialist van Nederland en België. In 2021 maakten we de stap naar Duitsland. Inmiddels hebben we daar 10 winkels en bouwen we volop verder aan onze positie op de Duitse markt, middels een omnichannelaanpak waarbij onze fysieke winkels en webshop naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. De winkels van Kamera Express kun je zien als clubhuizen. Plaatsen waar foto- en videoliefhebbers samenkomen om te sparren en deskundig advies in te winnen over hun hobby of beroep. Enthousiast, geïnspireerd, nieuwsgierig, betrokken, oprecht en verrast zijn woorden die passen bij Kamera Express. Deze eigenschappen zoeken we ook in jou.
  
  
**Wat ga je doen?**
Als Social Media & Content Marketeer Duitsland laat jij onze online community in Duitsland groeien. Dit is wat je doet:
  
  

* Je beheert de Duitse social -contentkalender en zorgt voor een consistente, herkenbare aanwezigheid op onze social -mediakanalen.
* Je plant, creëert en publiceert lokale content voor kanalen als Instagram, Facebook en YouTube, samen met de andere marketeers en ons videoteam.
* Je weet welk type content per kanaal werkt en vertaalt trends naar formats die passen bij de Duitse doelgroep.
* Je reist regelmatig naar events en winkels in Duitsland, legt die momenten vast en maakt er content van die onze lokale teams, services en expertise laat zien.
* Je werkt aan (influencer-)samenwerkingen en het Ambassadeursprogramma in Duitsland. Samen met partners bedenk je creatieve concepten die lokale acties op een authentieke manier naar onze kanalen brengen.
* Je stemt af met het video- en vormgevingsteam en bewaakt de kwaliteit en consistentie van de content.
* Je monitort de prestaties van je content, analyseert social-KPI's en verbetert continu op basis van data.
* Je test nieuwe formats en invalshoeken om bereik en betrokkenheid te vergroten.
* Je bent onderdeel van het marketingteam en werkt nauw samen met collega's in Nederland én Duitsland.

**Wie ben jij?**

* Je hebt 2–3 jaar ervaring in social media en contentmarketing en weet hoe je content maakt die past bij de doelgroep én het kanaal.
* Je voelt je thuis op Instagram, Facebook en YouTube en volgt actief nieuwe formats, trends en ontwikkelingen.
* Je combineert creativiteit met resultaatgerichtheid en gebruikt data om content steeds beter te laten presteren.
* Samenwerken gaat je makkelijk af: je schakelt soepel met collega's, ambassadeurs en partners.
* Je draagt actief bij aan het versterken van onze Duitse community.
* Affiniteit met fotografie en/of videografie is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Duits.
* Ervaring met social-planningtools is een pré.

**Wat bieden wij?**

* Een marktconform salaris
* 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis
* Een fiets via ons Lease-a-Bike-beleid
* Korting op alle producten en diensten van de Kamera Express Groep (Kamera Express, BudgetCam en Profotonet)
* 1 keer per 2 weken een georganiseerde lunch
* De mogelijkheid om via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland met belastingvoordeel te sporten
* Exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at work
* Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Detailhandel
* Mogelijkheid tot leren en ontwikkelen, via GoodHabitz kun je meer dan 150 trainingen volgen op het gebied van professionele vaardigheden, persoonlijke groei en leiderschap, vitaliteit en nog veel meer
* Tafeltennis en darten op kantoor
* Regelmatig themaborrels met leuke activiteiten

**Solliciteren**
Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel? Stuur je cv en motivatie via het sollicitatieformulier. We kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten.
  
  
Let op! In verband met vakanties, verwachten we in de eerste week van augustus reactie te kunnen geven op jouw sollicitatie.

job.title: Marketing Content Specialist @ TEAM (Heerenveen, Friesland, Netherlands)
job.description:

Reageer uiterlijk woensdag 4 november met je cv en korte motivatie via hallo@team.nl, t.a.v. Pim Balkestein. Daarna plannen we direct de eerste gesprekken.

job.title: Social Media-Manager:in @ Worst Behavior GmbH (Berlin, Germany)

WRSTBHVR wurde 2014 mit der Vision gegründet, Ready-to-Wear mit Streetwear-Ästhetik und progressiven Designelementen zu verbinden, ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität einzugehen. **Deine Rolle**

Wir möchten Social Media bei WRSTBHVR neu denken und strategisch weiterentwickeln. * Operative Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und TikTok
* Planung, Pflege und Steuerung des Content Calendars
* Entwicklung neuer Social-First-Formate und eigenständiger Content-Ideen
* Planung und Umsetzung von Content für Drops, Kampagnen, Events und Collaborations
* Eigenständige Produktion von Social Content - idealerweise inklusive Fotografie, Videoaufnahme und Schnitt

* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Creative, Brand und E-Commerce

**Das bringst du mit**

* mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Social Media Management, idealerweise im Fashion-, Lifestyle- oder Culture-Umfeld

* starkes Gespür für Fashion, Visuals, Storytelling und Brand Identity
